rules.statement: The bank is not liable for a guarantee signed by its manager without express authority, and the bank's actions in disposing of the money according to the plaintiff’s wishes do not constitute liability under a mistaken belief.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held , that the manager had no authority in terms of his appointment to bind the Bank in respect of the guarantee and that the Bank was not liable. Held, further, that the Bank was in the position of a mandatory, who has fully performed his mandate before any mistake had been discovered."

meta.parties: Adaikappa Chettiar v. Thomas Cook & Sons Ltd
